shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Transient search results only; source custom property --shadow-overlay.

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Search wrapper focus-within state, not surface elevation.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared button and graph transition curve.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Button background and text color transition.

motion.name: graph-state
motion.purpose: Graph edge stroke/opacity and node-dot scale transition.

motion.name: refresh-spin
motion.purpose: Busy refresh icon; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none!important; transition: none!important; scroll-behavior: auto!important
motion.purpose: Applied to all elements and pseudo-elements when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Charcoal action used to open the full note reader.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Read full page<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;font-weight:500;border-radius:6px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));background:var(--accent,#252525);color:var(--paper,#ffffff);border:0}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-strong,#050505)}.ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Bordered secondary action for graph focus and refresh.
components.html: <button class="ds-quiet"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="2" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><rect x="16" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/><path d="M12 8v4M5 16v-4h14v4"/></svg>Focus</button>
components.css: .ds-quiet{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;font-weight:500;border-radius:6px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),color 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1));background:var(--paper,#ffffff);color:#5a5a5a;border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e2e2)}.ds-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:#ededed;border-color:#c6c6c6}.ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-quiet:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-quiet{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Compact unboxed icon action with a pale hover state.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Close preview"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M6 18 18 6"/></svg></button>

components.name: Text button
components.description: Unboxed navigation within the graph work area.
components.css: .ds-text{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent-strong,#050505);padding:2px 6px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-text{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Pale search wrapper; focus is shown on the whole field.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input aria-label="Search your notes" placeholder="Search your brain"/></label>

components.name: Rail navigation
components.description: Dark rail with an inverted active row.

components.name: Page list row
components.description: Flat selectable row used in the reading index.
components.css: .ds-row{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:14px 13px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#e4e4e4;cursor:pointer}.ds-row-content{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-row strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#424242;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-row small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#666666);margin-top:6px}.ds-row svg{color:#929292}.ds-row:hover{background:#e4e4e4}.ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-row,.ds-row-content{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Status chip
components.description: Outlined text status from the change reader; meaning is written explicitly.

components.name: Selected graph node
components.description: A selected whole-note marker with ring and readable caption.
components.css: .ds-graph-demo{background:var(--canvas,#f6f6f6);height:100px;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-node{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:30px;min-height:30px;padding:0;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--projects,#4b4b4b);border:2px solid var(--canvas,#f6f6f6);box-sizing:content-box;outline:1px solid var(--projects,#4b4b4b);outline-offset:4px;transform:scale(1.12);transition:transform 220ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-caption{position:absolute;top:calc(50% + 17px);white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;background:#ffffff;color:var(--ink,#222222);padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #cfcfcf;border-radius:4px}.ds-node:hover .ds-dot{transform:scale(1.25)}.ds-node:hover .ds-caption{color:#303030;background:#e2e2e2}.ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-caption,.ds-dot,.ds-graph-demo,.ds-node{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Inline note link
components.description: Resolved note reference rendered as an inline action.
components.css: .ds-reading{font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9;color:#4f4f4f}.ds-wiki{display:inline;padding:0 1px;background:#efefef;color:#565656;border:0;border-radius:3px;font:inherit;line-height:inherit;text-align:left;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:#c0c0c0;text-underline-offset:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-wiki:hover{background:#dddddd;color:#3b3b3b}.ds-wiki:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #252525); outline-offset: 3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-reading,.ds-wiki{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
Brain uses a clean, minimalist black-and-white interface for exploring connected notes. The black navigation rail anchors pale working space and white reading surfaces; compact controls and explicit labels keep the knowledge itself prominent. Neutral grays express hierarchy without decorative color.

The implemented system uses one system sans for interface and reading text, fine dividers, restrained rounded controls, and flat panes. Graph selection adds a ring, stronger connections, and a readable caption; reading expands into a generous white column. This record describes the current source implementation after the user’s explicit monochrome revision, not an approved image composition.
keyCharacteristics: Black navigation, off-white graph space, and white reading panes.
Compact interface typography paired with spacious reading line height.
Flat panes separated by fine rules; shadows reserved for search overlays.
Text, shape, and selection treatment carry meaning alongside grayscale markers.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Use black, white, and neutral grays throughout the interface. The user explicitly rejected colored decorative accents.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep full-page note content and change readers within the implemented 70ch measure; compact previews use the inspector’s available width.

rules.name: The Flat Pane Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and fine borders to separate persistent panes. Reserve the overlay shadow for transient search results.

dos: Do preserve the black rail, off-white working canvas, and white reading surfaces.
Do pair grayscale collection dots and activity states with explicit names or symbols.
Do use the selected graph ring and caption, with connection emphasis on selection, hover, or keyboard focus.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do use concise sentence-case interface text and readable, flowing note content.
donts: Don’t reintroduce violet or other colored decorative accents.
Don’t turn the open graph or reader into a stack of shadowed dashboard cards.
Don’t add decorative display headlines or labels above headings.
Don’t rely on subtle differences between folder grays to identify a collection.
Don’t show the collection filter in Changes, where it does not filter the activity list.
